findings.claim: All 11 Portal journeys (JNY-030…040) and all 19 Portal UCs are mapped to the combined label 'CP-03 / CP-08'. That includes items with no PEC content, such as fines, CRLV-e, SNE, the BAT record, ombudsman, payment and LGPD access. COMPLETION-PLAN.md §4 and its medical-delegation section limit CP-08 to the seven citizen PEC views and say there must be no unconditional CP-03↔CP-08 dependency. The dual label blurs that line: under the PEC-last rule (ADR-0034/R-0030), Portal work could be held back or counted under CP-08. inventory-validation.json also records 'each_JNY_UC_JW_has_exactly_one_mapping: PASS', which is false when mappings are dual. The four RAIT JNY and 43 RAIT UC rows use the same kind of label ('CP-01 / CP-02').
findings.fix: Give each Portal JNY/UC one outcome. Use CP-03 by default. Use CP-08, or 'CP-03 with the PEC producer contract per P7', only for the PEC-dependent items, e.g. UC-PORTAL-014 and JNY-037, plus any item the source shows belongs to the seven PEC Portal views. Split the RAIT rows into CP-01 or CP-02 where the source makes that clear. Otherwise correct the 'exactly one mapping' PASS claim in inventory-validation.json.

findings.claim: CP-05 schedules 'connect … the local/homologation TEAT-mobile session/offline/sync behavior'. C-0003 §1 (line 79) lists teat-mobile as homologation under ADR-0033 and 'fora do escopo de ligação (C-0002 §6)'. The homologation UI/workflow delivery belongs to closed R-0013 under ADR-0033, and C-0002 §6 excludes productive TEAT mobile. Neither §3 nor §8 records an Owner decision bringing teat-mobile wiring into the local campaign. The prompt asked whether local TEAT-mobile was kept separate from production; here it is added to CP-05 without that decision.
findings.fix: Restate CP-05: TEAT-mobile homologation was delivered under R-0013/ADR-0033 and teat-mobile stays outside C-0003 wiring scope. Remaining TEAT-mobile UC/JNY obligations are either already delivered as homologation or CP-11 (#108–112). If teat-mobile wiring is wanted, list it as an explicit Owner scope proposal in §8 rather than putting it in CP-05.

findings.claim: Eight unstruck DT rows (DT-001/002/003/012/016/019/104/111) are mapped to 'CP-00 / affected product outcome'. CP-00 is review-only and has no implementation, and no outcome is named for these rows. Each has a source-identifiable destination: DT-003 (archive the senatran origin) is CP-09 parity/freeze/retirement and needs separate authority. DT-002 (RC/mutation-floor debt) touches the B17/OD-C3-004 exclusion and the #121 residual RC claims, which the crosswalk routes to CP-07/CP-10. DT-104 is PEC (CP-08). DT-111 is TEAT/BOAT (CP-05). DT-016 is the TEAT sync window (CP-05, value still open per steering H54). DT-019 is TEAT removal (CP-05). DT-012 is collection under steering H53 (CP-02/CP-03).
findings.fix: Name the destination outcome for each row. Give DT-002 the same destination as #121, and note that the mutation part stays excluded under OD-C3-004.
